import pygame, video_game
from video_game.main import run_game
from video_game.engine import config
from video_game.engine.native_room_assets import load_native_room_family
from video_game.engine.crt_renderer import CRTRenderer
from video_game.engine.state_machine import GameStateMachine
print("installed",video_game.__file__)
assert run_game(max_frames=2)==2
pygame.init(); pygame.display.set_mode((960,540))
for room,size in [("act_01_approach",(960,288)),("act_01_salvage_yard",(640,288)),("act_01_dish_catwalk",(640,288))]:
 assert load_native_room_family(config.ASSETS_DIR,room,size) is not None
m=GameStateMachine(CRTRenderer(scale=1)); assert m.start_new_game()[0]
for room,spawn in [("approach","bunker_exit"),("salvage_yard","yard_entrance"),("dish_catwalk","catwalk_start")]:
 m.change_state(config.STATE_FIELD_OPS,room="act_01/"+room+".json",spawn=spawn); assert m.current_scene.native_approach is not None; m.render()
m.close();pygame.quit();print("installed game and three room families OK")
